description: A "closes today… Closing TONIGHT at 12AM" pre-registration post sent 18:32 local time was confirmed at 0.9 as registration.closes = the NEXT day (consfyi/data#130): 12AM read as 00:00 of the following date. The right close is the post's own local day. Post text is Confuror's, captured from the run log; the con, DID, URL, and timestamps are synthetic. The post's UTC day is also the next day, so a UTC-day rule would mistake the slip for a same-day close.

posts.text: 🏜 Pre-Registration for #Confuror2026 closes today! Last chance to get a General Pass, which includes access to all days of the event. You will also be able to get a Day Pass in the future. 📅 Closing TONIGHT at 12AM! 🎟 Get your tickets: confuror.org/en/registrat... 🎨: The Neighbor Yeen

expect_absent.reason: "TONIGHT at 12AM" closes at the end of the post's own local day, not on the next date

_comment: Local post time is TODAY+0 18:32 (UTC-6). The expect entry pins what the prompt rule should produce; merge() then holds it as a same-day close (CON-60) when no deadline is stored.
